title: Behind the broadcasts.
subtitle: My journey in esports production.
note: Backend operations. Live execution. A show that keeps moving.

items.description: Leading esports live-production backend operations, with a primary focus on Free Fire tournament workflows and production reliability.
Managed live stream setup, overlays, backend production workflows, and technical broadcast support for esports events.
Built hands-on experience with streaming tools, scene control, graphics workflows, and backend coordination in community esports production.
